name: Rasayana
subtitle: Ashwagandha & Amla Age-Defying Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A restorative nectar crafted to preserve the natural youthfulness and vitality of your hair. Rooted in the ancient Ayurvedic philosophy of 'Rasayana' or rejuvenation, this blend unites the adaptogenic fortitude of Ashwagandha with the antioxidant-rich purity of Amla. Infused with delicate saffron threads in a warming sesame base, it works deeply to encourage thicker, more resilient strands that reflect a timeless grace.

ingredients.name: Ashwagandha Root
ingredients.role: Strengthens follicles and supports scalp resilience against environmental stress

ingredients.name: Amla Fruit
ingredients.role: Delivers potent antioxidants to preserve natural hair vitality

ingredients.name: Saffron Threads
ingredients.role: Stimulates the scalp and imparts a subtle, warming radiance

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.role: Deeply penetrating base that anchors and nourishes aging roots

whyThisHerb: Ashwagandha acts as a steadfast adaptogen, shielding the scalp from the toll of daily stressors, while Amla delivers a concentrated surge of youth-preserving nutrients.

howToUse.title: Warm
howToUse.description: Pour a few drops into the palm of your hand and rub together to gently warm the delicate saffron threads.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Work the oil slowly into your roots, applying firm but gentle pressure to stimulate the scalp.

howToUse.title: Rest
howToUse.description: Leave on overnight, allowing the adaptogenic herbs the time they need to deeply penetrate and restore.

howToUse.title: Cleanse
howToUse.description: Wash away the following morning with a gentle cleanser to reveal revitalized, fortified hair.
